Who Can Ride?

How Does It Work?

BRATS On-Demand is a convenient on-demand transit service that takes multiple people heading in the same direction and transports them in a shared van or bus (i.e. a shared ride). Tell us approximately what time you would like to depart for your trip, or let us know if there is a specific time you need to be somewhere. BRATS charges a low mileage fare. You will be notified of your fare before you book your trip. Please visit www.ridebrats.com for details.
